items.label: 2025 Latest Android 13 OS
items.value: New upgrades Android 13.0 OS Pure Snapdragon 665AIE processor chip, 8GB RAM + 256GB ROM, 8 CORES fast boot. Support 4G SIM card, Wireless Carplay & Android Auto.

items.label: Powerful Car Head Unit
items.value: 13.6 inch 1920*1080 screen resolution capacitive Multi-Touch screen. Support HD 1080P video Compatible format; Bluetooth 5.0 hands-free phone call; Synchronize contact list; Built-in WiFi function; Built-in Google Play Store; Built-in GPS Offline Map; Support Online Map; 4*45W Audio Output; 7850 amplifier; 9 Equalizers Compatible for Sound; NXP6686 Radio Chip; AM / FM with RDS; Support AUX-IN Audio; USB port; Support Steering Wheel Control and more.

items.label: Fully Plug and Play
items.value: Plug and play, no cutting/joint. Fully compatible with OEM intouch. No need to connect steering wheel control wires or debug AUX.

items.label: Notice
items.value: This product does not have DVD drive. Installation manual and online tech support available. Demo video available online. In order to avoid problems during installation or use, please send us a photo of your car's dashboard and tell us the year and model of your car after placing an order.
